title: Insurance Coverage & Claims Credit Minimum Schedule for Missing-Information Corrections
content:
**Schedule — the credit minimum on missing-information corrections (CO-16), Insurance Coverage & Claims.**

The missing-information correction's credit minimum follows the calendar days from the claim's filing date to today:

| Calendar days from the claim's filing date to today | Credit minimum |
|---|---|
| At most 30 (the prompt credit days) | 2.00 USD (prompt credit minimum) |
| More than 30 and at most 120 (the seasoned credit days) | 5.00 USD (seasoned credit minimum) |
| More than 120 | 25.00 USD (standard credit minimum) |

**Use of the minimum.** Billing-correction credits on the order count toward a missing-information correction only once their total reaches the credit minimum; "reaches" includes equality.

## Boundary rows

| Days since filing | Credit minimum |
|---|---|
| 30 | 2.00 |
| 31 | 5.00 |
| 120 | 5.00 |
| 121 | 25.00 |

## Hypothetical reading

A claim filed 64 days ago has a credit minimum of 5.00 USD: billing-correction credits totalling 5.00 USD reach it, a total of 4.99 USD does not.
